context: Tests whether the agent correctly interprets a sync JSON output that contains changes, conflicts, AND errors simultaneously — without being told what structure to use for the report.

checklist.name: Report is not empty
checklist.description: sync-report.md is produced and contains a substantive report (noChanges is false, there are conflicts and errors — silence would be wrong)

checklist.name: Created timezones reported with context
checklist.description: Report mentions both new timezone segments (America/Chicago and Europe/Berlin) with their dates or trip labels

checklist.name: Deleted timezone reported separately
checklist.description: Report clearly distinguishes the deleted Asia/Singapore segment from the created ones — not listed as just another change

checklist.name: OOO block counts reported
checklist.description: Report mentions OOO block activity (2 created, 1 deleted)

checklist.name: Conflict warning with both trip names
checklist.description: Report warns about the overlap and names both trips: Open Source Summit and PlatformCon

checklist.name: Conflict date included
checklist.description: Report includes the overlap date 2026-04-24 in the conflict warning

checklist.name: Error reported
checklist.description: Report includes the error about failing to set priority for PlatformCon — does not silently drop it because the errors array is non-empty

checklist.name: Error contextualized
checklist.description: Report connects the error (PlatformCon priority failure) to the conflict (PlatformCon overlaps with Open Source Summit) or at least presents them in a way that makes the relationship apparent

checklist.name: Uses trip labels from segments
checklist.description: Report uses human-readable trip labels (e.g., 'KubeCon - Austin') from the segments array rather than only raw timezone names

checklist.name: No fabricated data
checklist.description: Report does not invent details not present in the JSON (no made-up trip names, dates, or counts beyond what the data contains)
